That night Elias returned to his tower, lit the lamp, and felt, for the first time in years, that the darkness beyond the glass was not empty.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台调低音量的机器。高架桥上偶有出租车划过，尾灯把湿漉漉的路面染成暗红；便利店的白光守着打盹的店员，蒸笼仍轻轻冒气。环卫车转过空荡的街口，惊起几只麻雀。远处塔吊停在楼群之间，最早一班地铁正在地下苏醒。天际泛起一线灰蓝，夜市收拢最后的烟火，而早餐铺已推开门，让热豆浆的香气先一步迎接清晨。", "w03": "- Recursion is solving a big problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- The instructions repeat on that smaller problem, like opening smaller and smaller nesting dolls.\n- There is always a stopping point at the tiniest problem, so the repeating does not go on forever."}
